title.narrative: Infrastructure Development Investment Program for Tourism - Tranche 1

description.narrative:
As part of the Investment Program, the Project aims to complete subprojects under four or five different components of the Investment Program in the State of Himachal Pradeesh (Part A).
A. Component 1: Urban Infrastructure and Service Improvement B. Component 2: Connectivity Improvement C. Component 3: Quality Enhancement of Natural and Cultural Attractions D. Component 4: Community-based Activities E. Component 5: Capacity Development, Community Participation and Project Management

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Increased volume of domestic and international tourists to destinations within each participating state

30% increase in average length of stay of tourists in four participating states Progress/Status: Completed; Average length of stay of tourists increased in Punjab by 8% and In Himachal Pradesh, it would be assessed during project completion report preparation. Data Source: State tourims reports and statistics Program performance monitoring repors Independent social and market surveys Project completion reports Actual value:

40% increase in total domestic tourism in four participating states Progress/Status: Completed: Punjab - Increase in 600%domestic tourists. Himachal Pradesh - Increase in 93% domestic tourists. Data Source: State tourims reports and statistics Program performance monitoring repors Independent social and market surveys Project completion reports Actual value:

40% increase in total international tourists in four participating states Progress/Status: Completed: Punjab - Increase in 500% international tourists. Himachal Pradesh - Increase in 20% international tourists. Data Source: State tourims reports and statistics Program performance monitoring repors Independent social and market surveys Project completion reports Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Greater participation by local communities in tourism-related economic activities Indicator: Around 125 individual spread over 6 communities trained on heritage management and tourism-related skills (target 30% women) Progress/Status: Completed for Punjab and Himachal and for Himachal Pradesh: 5316 persons trained with 2,860 women (54%).For Punjab 172 individuals (164 women) trained in 15 Self Help Groups. Data Source: Quarterly progress reports ADB review mission aide memoires Independent social and market surveys Project completion reports Actual value:

Output: Improved connectivity Indicator: Himachal Pradesh: Improved access to tourist attractions by way of 5 km of last-mile connectivity improvement and improved signage Progress/Status: Improved access to tourist attractions by way of 5 km of last-mile connectivity work has been completed in Himachal Pradesh. Data Source: Project quarterly progress reports ADB review mission aide-memoiures Independent social and market surveys Project completion reports Actual value:

Output: Improved connectivity Indicator: Pubjab: Improved access to tourist attractions by way of around 5 km of connectivity improvement inclusive of roadside infrastructure and improved signage Progress/Status: Improved access to tourist attractions by way of 5 km of last-mile connectivity work has been completed in Punjab. Data Source: Project quarterly progress reports ADB review mission aide-memoiures Independent social and market surveys Project completion reports Actual value:

Output: Improved connectivity Indicator: Throughout MFF implementation (outputs 3 and 4): Women's participation in consultative processes for selection of subproject sites encouraged (target: 30% women), women's equal access to employment and training opportunities on core labor standards (including equal wages for work of equal value) promoted (target: 30% women) Information, education and communication, and awareness campaigns carried out to mitigate health, social and gender-related risks associated with infrastructure development Progress/Status: Consultation process for women for the selection of subproject sites has been organised and would be assessed during project completion report preparation. Data Source: Project quarterly progress reports ADB review mission aide-memoiures Independent social and market surveys Project completion reports Actual value:

Data Source: Project quarterly progress reports ADB review mission aide-memoirs Independent social and market surveys Project completion reports Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Data Source: Project quarterly progress reports ADB review mission aide-memoirs Independent social and market surveys Project completion reports Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Data Source: Quarterly progress reports ADB review mission aide memoires Independent social and market surveys Project completion reports Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Data Source: Quarterly progress reports ADB review mission aide memoires Independent social and market surveys Project completion reports Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Data Source: Quarterly progress reports ADB review mission aide memoires Independent social and market surveys Project completion reports Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Output: Strengthened capacity of concerned sector agencies and local communities for planning, development, management and marketing of tourist destinations and attractions Indicator: Capacity Development Training programs on environment, culture and tourism developed and implemented 250 staff of state tourism offices and related organizations (tour operators and guides) trained in environment, culture, tourism planning, coordination, monitoring and marketing (target: 30% women) Adequate community-level tourism development units set up and made functional by the State PIUs (target: 30% women); and At least one public-private partnership transactions per participating state supported Esablishing tourist information systems and/or centers Progress/Status: Capacity development training program have been completed. Punjab: 35 training programs undertaken with 1,329 participants (462 women). Himachal Pradesh: 831 (613 women) participants trained. Data Source: Project quarterly progress reports ADB review mission aide-memoiures Independent social and market surveys Project completion reports Master plans Management plans Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Output: Strengthened capacity of concerned sector agencies and local communities for planning, development, management and marketing of tourist destinations and attractions Indicator: Fostering Community Participation Gender-sensitive value chain analyses undertaken to establish stronger links between tourism and local economies Schemes for tourism-based, gender-responsive livelihood generaion involving social mobilization and micro finance services designed and implemented Tourism-related skills development activities in heritage management and hospitality-related skills implemented in the communities Partnerships between communities, private sector and public sector established for enhanced tourist destination management and viable community tourism product development Progress/Status: Foster Community participation program have been completed in Punjab and Himachal Pradesh. Data Source: Project quarterly progress reports ADB review mission aide-memoiures Independent social and market surveys Project completion reports Master plans Management plans Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Output: Strengthened capacity of concerned sector agencies and local communities for planning, development, management and marketing of tourist destinations and attractions Indicator: Marketing and Promotion Promotional materials on proposed tourist destinations/attractions developed and disseminated Independent arrangements for marketing and promotion program in place Linkages established with market for community-based products Progress/Status: Marketing and promotion program have been completed. Data Source: Project quarterly progress reports ADB review mission aide-memoiures Independent social and market surveys Project completion reports Master plans Management plans Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Output: Strengthened capacity of concerned sector agencies and local communities for planning, development, management and marketing of tourist destinations and attractions Indicator: Planning SLBs defined for ULBs/RLBs/associated project entitites, and data collection and monitoring carried out Organizational and financial management measures for state tourism organizaions and associated project entitites, including planning, protecting, and managing nature and culture-based tourist attractions Sustainable funding ensured to meet required O&M expenditure of assets created by ULBs/RLBs For ULBs/RLBs, evaluation undertaken, and steps taken to ensure adequacy of budgetary provision for meeting O&M expenditure including introduction of appropriate taxes or admission/user charges Progress/Status: Planning work has been completed.
